configuration and drawing/BOM revision

wood species and supply moisture

cloth fibre/finish/moisture

leather pocket composition
each hardware article and finish
each whole preparation composition and supplier permission
actual machining/finishing/assembly/test route and outsourced stages
measured whole net mass M and calibrated weighing
no default kg per table
unique first-release Q and failed/Q=0 periods

finished-stock history and original Qc

independent species/water/carbon/physical balances and supply-article component bridges
native UUID restrictions and supplier compatibility
upstream/treatment gaps and uncertainty

product_flow.name: 用于露天游乐场、桌子和室内游戏的其他设备（包括用于台球戏、弹球机、纸牌游戏及自动滚木球专用桌台的设备），不包括使用电视接收机的电视游戏

required_qualifiers: 场址与期间
配置及图纸或BOM版本

无默认每桌kg
